references.text: Also mentions Moab as an enemy of Israel, where Eglon was king
The Israelites sent Ehud with tribute (מִנְחָה) to Eglon, king of Moab
Uses the same word מִנְחָה for a gift or tribute brought to a ruler
Also describes bringing מִנְחָה (tribute/gift) to a king
Describes Eglon's obesity in more detail when Ehud kills him and the fat closes around the sword
Mesha, king of Moab, also paid tribute to the king of Israel, showing the same practice with מִנְחָה
